messages:
Ava: Putting together a lean customer-facing go-live checklist for onboarding + account health + renewal flags. Needs: preflight, simple batch/cache guidance, streaming trigger, and a 2-question feedback flow.

Mateo: SRE guardrails to drop in: p95 < 300ms, p99 < 900ms (interactive). Default tenant throttle 30 rps. Circuit-break: trip if error_rate > 6% sustained over 90s. Recommend a 5-min warmup probe during initial ramp windows.

Priya: Brief, scannable batching/cache bullets for customers:
- Tiny (<30 rps): batch_size 1-2; inline prefill ok.
- Small (30-150 rps): batch_size 4-12; enable prefix prefill for top intents.
- Large (>150 rps): dynamic batching + consider a small reserved warm pool.
Cache TTLs: ephemeral conversation prefixes 1-10m, stable templates 3-24h. If median seq_len > 700, reduce batch sizes ~60%.

Ken: Preflight checklist (top of the one-pager):
1) Confirm warm pool enabled and capacity assigned.
2) Share 25 representative prompts.
3) Validate token caps and embedding config.
4) Run synthetic probe and confirm p95/p99 in dashboard.
5) Decide on streaming when tail latency is business-critical.

Ava: Renewal signals (AMs watch): 7-day MAU drop >15%, p99 jitter >20%, retry bursts (>3x baseline), or 2+ new issues in a week. Simple scoring to flag risk for outreach.

Priya: Feedback capture flow: Week-1 micro-survey (2 Qs: latency 1-5, quality 1-5). If any <=3 => open triage + 30-min debug, collect 8-12 failing prompts + outputs for evals.

Mateo: Tiny curl warmup customers can run: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"openchat-7b","input":"warmup-check"}' | jq '.latency_ms'`

infra-bot: Managed action: `/run warmup --tenant <id> --profile brief`. Logs: `/logs/warmup/<id>`. Tag: `cs:warmup-v1`.

Ava: Great. @Priya will draft the 1-pager and the short Slack template. @Mateo will add the probe script to ops. We'll pin the doc to #cs-runbooks and run a 15-min AM walkthrough next week.
